Class NotebookHeatbar

java.lang.Object
java.awt.Component
java.awt.Container
javax.swing.JComponent
org.aetheris.swing.NotebookHeatbar
All Implemented Interfaces:
ImageObserver, MenuContainer, Serializable
final class NotebookHeatbar extends JComponent
The NotebookHeatbar class paints the token fill against the context window. The track is 5 pixels tall. The needle is 2 pixels wide and 9 pixels tall. An amber post sits at 70 percent. A red post sits at 90 percent. The needle rests on the fill and lunges when the count changes. Crossing a post flashes the head ink once. A settled model count uses that same flash. Keystrokes update the estimate, not the settled count.

  • Constructor Details

    • NotebookHeatbar

      NotebookHeatbar()
      The constructor sizes the bar and starts no timer until a count arrives. The preferred width is 240 and the height is 9. The minimum width is 80. The tooltip names the fill, the 70 percent post, and the 90 percent post.

  • Method Details

    • showHeuristic

      void showHeuristic(int tokens, int window)
      The method shows the estimate from keystrokes. A negative token count is stored as 0. A negative window is stored as 0. A window of 0 paints an empty fill and still draws the posts. The same estimate and window, while a model count is held, returns without a change. The same estimate and window, while no model count is held, also returns without a change. Any other call clears the model hold and seats the estimate.
      Parameters:
      tokens - The tokens value is the estimate, and a negative count is stored as 0.
      window - The window is the context size, and 0 paints an empty fill.

    • showSettled

      void showSettled(int tokens)
      The method shows the model count after the text has settled. A negative count is stored as 0. The model hold stays on. This method does not call a host. A band change flashes that post. The settled flash runs even when the band does not change.
      Parameters:
      tokens - The tokens value is prompt_eval_count.

    • word

      String word()
      The method returns the label for the count now on the needle.
      Returns:
      The return value is est. tokens: followed by the shown count.

    • ink

      Color ink()
      The method returns the ink for the current fill. A flash in progress returns HEAD. Otherwise the ink follows the band of the shown fill.
      Returns:
      The return value is that color.

    • seat

      private void seat(int tokens, boolean moved, boolean settledFlash, int post)
      The method stores the shown count and starts motion when needed. The first seat only repaints. A moved count sets the lunge to 6. A band that rises above 0 flashes that post when no post was passed in. A post above 0, or a settled flash, runs for 8 ticks. The timer is armed and the bar repaints.
      Parameters:
      tokens - The tokens value is the count to show.
      moved - The flag is true when the count changed after the first seat.
      settledFlash - The flag is true when a settled count should flash.
      post - The post is the band to flash, or 0 when no post was named.

    • arm

      private void arm()
      The method starts the 16 millisecond timer when it is not already running.

    • tick

      private void tick()
      The method decays the lunge and the flash. A lunge above 0.4 is multiplied by 0.72. A smaller lunge becomes 0. A remaining flash tick is reduced by 1. The bar repaints. The timer stops when neither the lunge nor the flash is still live.

    • fill

      private static double fill(int used, int window)
      The method returns the fill as a fraction of the window. A window below 1 returns 0. A used count of 0 or less returns 0. A used count at or above the window returns 1.
      Parameters:
      used - The used value is the token count.
      window - The window is the context size.
      Returns:
      The return value is the fraction from 0 through 1.

    • band

      private static int band(double amount)
      The method maps a fill onto a band. A fill of 0 or less is band 0. A fill of 0.9 or more is band 3. A fill of 0.7 or more is band 2. Any smaller positive fill is band 1.
      Parameters:
      amount - The amount is the fill fraction.
      Returns:
      The return value is the band number.

    • bandInk

      private static Color bandInk(int band)
      The method returns the ink for a band. Band 3 and above is RED. Band 2 is AMBER. Band 1 is GREEN. Band 0 is TRACK.
      Parameters:
      band - The band is the number from band(double).
      Returns:
      The return value is that color.

    • paintComponent

      protected void paintComponent(Graphics graphics)
      The method paints the track, the fill, the two posts, and the needle. A width below 8 returns without painting. A height below 9 returns without painting. The fill uses HEAD while a flash is running. The needle is offset by the current lunge and stays inside the width.
      Overrides:
      paintComponent in class JComponent
      Parameters:
      graphics - The graphics context is the Swing paint surface.

    • paintPost

      private void paintPost(Graphics2D g2, int width, int top, double at, Color ink, int postBand)
      The method paints one vertical post. The x position is the fraction times the last pixel. A flash whose post matches this band uses HEAD.
      Parameters:
      g2 - The graphics context is the paint surface.
      width - The width is the component width in pixels.
      top - The top is the y of the 9-pixel mark.
      at - The fraction is where the post sits, such as 0.7 or 0.9.
      ink - The ink is the resting color of the post.
      postBand - The band is 2 for amber or 3 for red.

      void stopBeat()
